selection: Eight locked, never-matrix-exposed, scoreability-admitted public identities from distinct repositories. Each shared trajectory pauses at its first held terminal candidate.
instrument_treatment: Validator-proven indeterminate calls debit their full admitted bound; affected pairs are symmetric zeros and later independent tasks continue.
treatment: Control receives the existing terminal review. Treatment substitutes one terminal-decision-state/v2 projection for the registered repeated review and finalization messages. The state is capped at three evidence items, 1,536 bytes, and 384 measured tokens, and must reduce first-request input by at least 128 tokens.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and treatment-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
A validator-proven zero-byte indeterminate call is debited at its full admitted bound and its pair is retained as symmetric zeros.
Stop as soon as six eligible pairs are mathematically unreachable.
Any unbounded usage, nonterminal boundary, held-effect, ancestry, unregistered prompt difference, exposure, input-reduction, or token-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
